prompt: This image contains 4 chronological rows labelled f0, f8, f13, f16. Name directly visible features and frame labels, including blur, ghosting or distortions when truly visible. Do not assess full-body action, background or camera angle. Return JSON {"late_face_detail_retained":"yes|no|uncertain","frame_evidence":"string","limits":"string"}.
